1879-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1429-3545-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

225-851-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-851-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

765-4050-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

2092-4954-5873.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-4954-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Everglades and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1636-5371-7280-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Donatello.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-5371-7280-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

240-719-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-4050.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

4659-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-5913-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-5913-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Pinnacle Monk
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

6556-6867-6869.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater excluding Aang.
6556-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-5231-5563.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker, adding {R}.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

1486-1753-2872-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-2872-4452.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2872-4452.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

428-1694-1817-3090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
428-1694-1817-3090.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a copy of the Ghyrson Starn spell that isn't legendary.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

1479-4488-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-4488-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

539-1682-4131-4241.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
539-1682-4131-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1389-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that has a power of one or greater.
Otepec Huntmaster does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1389-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating a X/X Dinosaur creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Otepec Huntmaster by tapping it, giving the Dinosaur haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dinosaur token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1770-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1770-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

3132-3398-4050.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing and Hellkite Charger.
You have at least eight creature cards in your graveyard.
3132-3398-4050.description:
Declare Bladewing and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least eight 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Bladewing and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Zombie Knights, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
